description:
Mirantis Inc. seeks a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - Kubernetes & KubeVirt at its facility located at 14205 North Mopac Expressway, Austin, TX 78728. The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - Kubernetes & KubeVirt will architect and deliver enterprise-grade Kubernetes platforms deployed across hybrid AWS and Azure environments, supporting mission-critical workloads. Design, implement, and operate Kubernetes-based infrastructure to support both containerized and virtualized workloads, leveraging KubeVirt to unify VM and container management, reducing infrastructure complexity and improving operational efficiency. Build and maintain production observability platforms to improve mean time to resolution (MTTR) and overall system reliability. Establish and enforce DevSecOps standards, including Harbor registry security, image scanning, container security controls, access management, RBAC enforcement, and compliance baselines. Automate infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code, standardizing environments and reducing deployment times. Implement and operate Argo CD-based GitOps deployment workflows to ensure reproducible and auditable releases across environments. Lead cloud modernization initiatives, migrating legacy platforms to cloud-native architectures. Define and maintain organizational cloud governance, security policies, and compliance frameworks. Provide technical leadership through mentoring, technical design reviews, and collaboration with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. Implement and support multi-network pod configurations using Multus CNI to enable complex VM and container networking use cases. Implement and manage GitOps-based CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD and Helm to support controlled, auditable infrastructure changes. Develop and maintain reusable reference architectures and automation frameworks for repeatable Kubernetes deployments. Design and operate Kubernetes networking solutions for bare-metal and hybrid clusters, including MetalLB-based load balancing. Troubleshoot advanced Kubernetes networking issues involving CNI plugins, secondary interfaces, IPAM, and traffic routing. Integrate networking configurations with KubeVirt workloads requiring multiple network attachments. Telecommuting permitted.

 Education: Bachelor’s degree or foreign degree equivalent in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field.
 Experience: Five (5) years of post-baccalaureate progressive experience in job offered, Software Engineer, Software Developer, Systems Engineer, or in a related occupation.
 Academic training or work experience in the following:  
 1. Design and operation of production level Kubernetes clusters for enterprise workloads
 2. AWS or Azure production infrastructure, including hybrid or multi-cloud architecture design
 3. CI/CD pipeline implementation using Argo CD and JFrog Artifactory for automated application and infrastructure deployments
 4. Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Ansible for large-scale environment automation 
 5. Linux system administration in production environments
 6. DevSecOps practices, including Harbor registry security, access management, and compliance alignment
 7. Monitoring and observability platforms for production systems
 Applicants who are interested in this position should apply online at https://www.mirantis.com/careers search Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - Kubernetes & KubeVirt (REF1242M)

 What does Mirantis offer you? 



- Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;

- Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;

- Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;

- Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;

- Professional development and training;

- Attend conferences and working groups;

- Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;

- Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.
 

 It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com 



By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.
 
 We are a  Leader for Container Management  in G2 (#2 after AWS)!
